sets.title: DeckCheck sweep 2026-10-18: eleven standouts for the meanest bracket-4 Edgar — exile-wipe answers, death-triggered draw, distance drain, input
sets.source: deckcheck.co Explore Cards (Synergetic 300 + Recommendations 200), read against the DTI 28/96 scan and roast
sets.query: DeckCheck builder qb9leISdSZX6 → Explore Cards → Synergetic Cards / Recommendations; 320 distinct cards, 0 in the deck, 70 cut in earlier versions

cards.name: Clever Concealment
cards.why: convoke (the tokens pay), your permanents phase out: beats Farewell and an overloaded Cyclonic Rift, which Boros Charm and Flawless Maneuver do not — the roast's one valid critical point

cards.name: Enduring Tenacity
cards.why: Sanguine Bond on a 4-mana lifelink body that returns as an enchantment when it dies: a seventh combo half with Exquisite Blood, and a destroy wipe leaves the drain on the table

cards.name: Enduring Innocence
cards.why: draws a card whenever small creatures enter, once a turn — eminence tokens enter every turn; comes back as an enchantment after a destroy wipe; lifelink body

cards.name: Morbid Opportunist
cards.why: 3 mana, draw when creatures die, once a turn: death-triggered draw, the pilot's preferred shape for the turn 7-8 empty hand

cards.name: Tocasia's Welcome
cards.why: enchantment: draw when creatures with mana value 3 or less enter, once a turn — tokens are mv 0; survives creature wipes

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
cards.why: whenever you gain life, pay that much life to draw that many cards — a mana-free draw engine in a drain deck, and a tap drain

cards.name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
cards.why: 2 mana, the first time creatures you control die each turn each opponent loses 2 and you gain 2: action at a distance on a cheap body

cards.name: Vein Ripper
cards.why: 6 mana flyer: any creature dying is 2 drained from an opponent; ward—sacrifice a creature makes removal cost a body; the biggest distance payoff on either tab

cards.name: Dictate of Erebos
cards.why: flash: every token death makes each opponent sacrifice a creature; lands after a wipe resolves and turns the rebuild into removal

cards.name: Urza's Incubator
cards.why: Vampire spells cost 2 less; eminence triggers on cast, so cheaper casts are more tokens per turn — the input thesis

cards.name: Bolas's Citadel
cards.why: play from the top paying life, which this deck makes back; the bracket-4 card-advantage engine on the Recommendations tab
